text: Available as a terminal-based interface, desktop app, or IDE extension
quote: OpenCode is an open source AI coding agent. It's available as a terminal-based interface, desktop app, or IDE extension.

text: Supports any LLM provider by configuring your own API keys
quote: With OpenCode you can use any LLM provider by configuring their API keys.

text: Offers a curated 'Zen' list of tested and verified models from the OpenCode team
quote: OpenCode Zen is a list of tested and verified models provided by the OpenCode team.

text: Can add external tools via Model Context Protocol, supporting both local and remote MCP servers
quote: You can add external tools to OpenCode using the _Model Context Protocol_, or MCP. OpenCode supports both local and remote servers.

text: Guided flow to create a new custom agent with its own system prompt and permission config
quote: This command will guide you through creating a new agent with a custom system prompt and permission configuration.

text: Tab key lets you switch between primary agents mid-session
quote: You can use the **Tab** key to switch between primary agents during a session.

text: Plan agent can analyze code and review suggestions without making any code changes
quote: Use the plan agent to analyze code and review suggestions without making any code changes.

text: Agent skills feature discovers reusable instructions from repo or home directory, loaded on-demand
quote: Agent skills let OpenCode discover reusable instructions from your repo or home directory. Skills are loaded on-demand via the native `skill` tool

text: Provides a type-safe JS/TS SDK to build integrations and control OpenCode programmatically
quote: The opencode JS/TS SDK provides a type-safe client for interacting with the server. Use it to build integrations and control opencode programmatically.

text: TUI can connect to and operate against a remote OpenCode backend
quote: This allows using the TUI with a remote OpenCode backend.

text: Integrates with VS Code, Cursor, or any IDE with a terminal by running opencode directly
quote: OpenCode integrates with VS Code, Cursor, or any IDE that supports a terminal. Just run `opencode` in the terminal to get started.

text: Can fix an issue or implement a feature, working in a new branch and submitting a PR with the changes
quote: Ask OpenCode to fix an issue or implement a feature. And it will work in a new branch and submits a PR with all the changes.

text: Permission config determines whether an action auto-runs, prompts the user, or is blocked
quote: OpenCode uses the `permission` config to decide whether a given action should run automatically, prompt you, or be blocked.

text: --auto flag auto-approves permission requests that aren't explicitly denied, for unattended runs
quote: Start OpenCode with `--auto` to automatically approve permission requests that are not explicitly denied.

text: Lets users log in with GitHub to use their existing Copilot subscription
quote: **GitHub Copilot** Log in with GitHub to use your Copilot account

text: Lets users log in with OpenAI to use their existing ChatGPT Plus/Pro subscription
quote: **ChatGPT Plus/Pro** Log in with OpenAI to use your ChatGPT Plus or Pro account

text: Multi-session support lets you start multiple agents in parallel on the same project
quote: **Multi-session** Start multiple agents in parallel on the same project

text: Can share a link to any session for reference or debugging
quote: **Share links** Share a link to any session for reference or to debug

text: Desktop app supports tabs across macOS, Windows, and Linux
quote: Introducing tabs for desktop. Available on macOS, Windows, and Linux.

text: Can be run directly from the CLI with a natural-language prompt (e.g. 'opencode run "..."')
quote: opencode run "Explain how closures work in JavaScript"

text: Includes a fast, read-only agent specialized for exploring codebases
quote: A fast, read-only agent for exploring codebases.

text: opencode serve runs a headless HTTP server exposing an OpenAPI endpoint for clients
quote: The opencode serve command runs a headless HTTP server that exposes an OpenAPI endpoint that an opencode client can use.

text: Keyboard shortcut opens OpenCode in a split terminal view within the editor
quote: Use Cmd+Esc (Mac) or Ctrl+Esc (Windows/Linux) to open OpenCode in a split terminal view

text: Keyboard shortcut inserts file references directly into a session
quote: Use Cmd+Option+K (Mac) or Alt+Ctrl+K (Linux/Windows) to insert file references.

text: Centralized config can integrate with an SSO provider and restrict users to an internal AI gateway
quote: This centralized config can integrate with your SSO provider and ensures all users access only your internal AI gateway.
